author: fdoljanin
body:
#### PR description:

This PR generalizes HGCal trackster validation histogram handling and adds 2D efficiency, purity, fake, duplicate, and merge ratios. The new plots expose the dependence of trackster performance on combination of production radius and kinematics while retaining the existing 1D validation quantities.


Plots: https://fdoljani.web.cern.ch/2D/offline/offline_ticlTrackstersCLUE3DHigh/Efficiencies_byLCs/

#### PR validation:

- Successfully compiled with `scram b` in `CMSSW_20_1_0_pre1`.
- Ran workflow `34554.0` with 10,000 displaced photons using `ExtendedRun4D121`.
- Successfully completed RECO/VALIDATION/DQM and HARVESTING.
- Verified the harvested DQM output and the new 2D validation plots.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport; no backport is currently planned.
